timeline_entry.event: Sussex Police formally confirm Ben Carter as the victim in Crime Reference 47250093423, with PC Alan Russell assigned as investigating officer.

contradiction_entry.claim: Brighton Fringe leadership acted independently of any criminal implications in removing Ben Carter.
contradiction_entry.reality: Despite being aware of a live crime reference (47250093423) against Duncan Lustig-Prean for stalking and harassment, Brighton Fringe refused to acknowledge this or factor it into their board decision-making. Duncan retained sole control over the board minutes, while Sussex Police had already assigned an investigating officer (PC Alan Russell).
